💎 HIDDEN VALUE — The AI build-out isn't just chips. It runs on rare earths, uranium, and defense tech the market still prices like yesterday's news.

⚛️ $UUUU — Energy Fuels (Uranium)
• US uranium producer feeding the nuclear baseload that AI data centers need 24/7; supply is tight after years of underinvestment.
• Forward P/E 38.6, revenue growth +112%, gross margin 34.6%. Price $12.74 vs mean target $26.13 — 105% upside, Strong Buy.
• Catalyst: nuclear re-rating as hyperscalers sign long-term power deals; UUUU is a domestic, strategic supplier with real revenue inflection.
• Risk: still loss-making (profit margin -82.7%), high debt/equity 93.

🧲 $MP — MP Materials (Rare Earths)
• The only US rare earth mine-to-magnet play — essential for EV motors, robotics, wind, and defense; supply is concentrated outside the West.
• Forward P/E 50.2, revenue growth +118.6%, gross margin 37.2%. Price $47.74 vs mean target $77.78 — 63% upside, Strong Buy.
• Catalyst: government offtakes and domestic magnet production coming online; rare earth prices firming as strategic stockpiling accelerates.
• Risk: still unprofitable (profit margin -20.5%), EBITDA deeply negative.

🛰️ $KTOS — Kratos Defense (Drones/Autonomy)
• Single-source drone and autonomous systems for the rearmament supercycle; multi-year backlogs make revenue unusually visible.
• Revenue growth +22.6%, earnings growth +130.6%. Price $55.49 vs mean target $108.62 — 96% upside, Strong Buy from 21 analysts.
• Catalyst: defense budgets shifting to unmanned systems; space and hypersonics add optionality.
• Risk: expensive on PEG 36.4 and EV/EBITDA 104; thin margins (2.1% net).

🌊 $TMC — The Metals Company (Deep-Sea Metals)
• Polymetallic nodules for nickel, copper, cobalt — critical inputs for batteries and grid build-out; no Western supply chain exists yet.
• Price $4.01 vs mean target $11.00 — 174% upside, Strong Buy. Short interest 10.6%, institutions only 14.2% — underowned.
• Catalyst: regulatory clarity on deep-sea mining; strategic demand for non-Chinese metals.
• Risk: pre-revenue, negative book value, no margins — a binary bet.

🔋 $LAC — Lithium Americas (Lithium)
• US-based lithium developer for EV and battery storage; trades below book at P/B 0.8 — the cheapest asset play in the group.
• Price $3.10 vs mean target $5.71 — 85% upside. Debt/equity 46.8, but no revenue yet.
• Catalyst: Thacker Pass construction progress and lithium price floor; domestic supply security narrative.
• Risk: hold rating, pre-revenue, lithium prices still depressed.

Honest line: These are mostly turnarounds and strategic bets — the upside is real, but so is the execution risk. Do your own research on each before committing.
